In `total()` (`src/pricing.mjs`), each line contributes `(line.quantity || 1) * line.unitPrice`. JavaScript treats `0` as falsy, so `0 || 1` becomes `1` and the line is charged as `1 × 9 = 9` instead of `0 × 9 = 0`.

  const subtotal = lines.reduce((sum, line) => sum + (line.quantity ?? 1) * line.unitPrice, 0);

## Calculation (symptom → numbers)

| Input | Before (`\|\|`) | After (`??`) |
|--------|------------------|--------------|
